prompter.title: Prompter
prompter.description: Lyrics and chords, as smooth scroll or paginated view.

live-queue.title: Live queue
live-queue.description: The next songs of the setlist, with "Play next".

section-jump.title: Sections
section-jump.description: The song's sections from the timeline: the master jumps at the next bar or section end, or repeats a section - every device follows.

ready-check.title: Ready check
ready-check.description: The master asks whether everyone is ready and sees who is still missing; everyone else confirms in the notice.

active-setlist.title: Active setlist
active-setlist.description: Shows which setlist is active - also without live queue/next song.

show-transport.title: Show transport
show-transport.description: Play/pause/stop/reset for the current song - Gig or Solo practice, with or without a backing-track plugin.

visual-metronome.title: Visual metronome
visual-metronome.description: Flashes in time with the active song (BPM/meter), downbeat in its own colour.

loop-trainer.title: Loop trainer
loop-trainer.description: Solo practice: loops a part of the backing track seamlessly, optionally faster with every pass (pitch stays).

tempo-nudge.title: Tempo correction
tempo-nudge.description: Live +/- adjustment of the click/metronome tempo without changing the song's BPM.

click-track.title: Click
click-track.description: Synthesized click/metronome sound, on/off - plays on the device set up as click output.

audio-mix.title: My mix
audio-mix.description: Volume of track, click and announcements on this device - a fader and mute each.

stems.title: Stems
stems.description: Solo practice: a song's parts (drums, bass, guitar …) instead of the track - a fader, mute and solo each.
stems.loading: Tracks are loading - until then the track plays.
stems.error: Tracks could not be loaded - the track plays.
stems.none: This song has no tracks. In the song editor under Audio: “Separate stems” or upload stems.
stems.onlyPractice: Tracks only play in Solo practice - in Gig mode the track plays.

track-override.title: Variant & track
track-override.description: Switches a song's backing track for now (e.g. "1 guitar" instead of "no guitar"); in Solo practice also the variant.

midi-status.title: Foot switch
midi-status.description: State of the MIDI foot switch, jump to the next song part.

dashboard-switcher.title: Dashboard switcher
dashboard-switcher.description: Large buttons to switch between dashboards.

iem-more-me.title: More me (IEM)
iem-more-me.description: Your own faders for the in-ear mix.

quick-actions.title: Quick actions
quick-actions.description: Large buttons for ad-hoc show cues.

lighting-cues.title: Lighting cues
lighting-cues.description: Large buttons for light cues on the DMX desk.

system-health.title: System status
system-health.description: Traffic-light overview of all plugin capabilities, for setup/soundcheck.

sync-check.title: Sync check
sync-check.description: Flashes with the server clock - hold two devices side by side and check that they blink together.

tuner.title: Tuner
tuner.description: Chromatic tuner using the tablet's microphone.

stage-messenger.title: Stage messenger
stage-messenger.description: Flash a short message to everyone or single musicians: "5 minutes left", "Tune guitar", your own quick messages.

show-notes.title: Show notes
show-notes.description: Live notes from band and crew, visible in the show report.

backup-status.title: Backup status
backup-status.description: At-a-glance indicator whether the backup plugin is reachable.

festival-clock.title: Festival clock
festival-clock.description: Expected end of the rest of the setlist - turns red when it ends after the target time (curfew).

clock.title: Clock
clock.description: Large, easy-to-read digital clock for the stage.

separator.title: Separator
separator.description: A simple line to set dashboard areas apart.

device-status.title: Device status
device-status.description: Live connection state of one chosen device.

custom-trigger.title: Trigger button
custom-trigger.description: A button for any action: show, sections, playback or a device command - momentary, latching or timed.

chord-reference.title: Chord lookup
chord-reference.description: Pick a root and chord type: notes, intervals, guitar shape and keyboard.

circle-of-fifths.title: Circle of fifths
circle-of-fifths.description: Tap a key: relative key, dominant, subdominant and key signature at a glance.

co.local: Applies only on this device and only to this song.

mix.silentHere: In Gig mode this device plays no sound - the mix here applies to practice and the timeline.

click.noOutput: No click output device set up
click.caption: Click

trig.masterOnly: Only the master controls the show
trig.label: Label
trig.labelHint: Empty or “Trigger”: the name of the switch.
trig.legacy: The previous command had invalid JSON and is sent without these values - please choose again.

switcher.hint: Shows the same dashboards as the menu: hide and sort under ☰ → Dashboards → “Arrange”, Gig/Solo in the dashboard’s settings.

fest.caption: Expected end
fest.setTarget: Set a target end in the setlist

rc.askTitle: Ask every tablet whether the band is ready
rc.caption: Ready check
rc.masterStarts: The master starts the ready check

sj.none: No sections with a time in the timeline
sj.noEnd: This section has no known end - choose “End of bar”.
sj.whilePlaying: Jump while the song is playing

tr.noControl: This device currently has no control over the show
tr.extended: Extended - runs past the regular length

msg.notSignedIn: Not sent - this device is not signed in to the band.
msg.offline: Not sent - Stage server not reachable.

to.oneTrack: Only one track - no switch needed

tun.insecure: The microphone needs a secure connection (HTTPS or localhost) - not available over http in the LAN, whatever the device.
tun.unsupported: The microphone is not supported by this browser.
